title: Core Enrollment Kit
description: Four reference-dependent images define a school open-day enrollment system across poster, prospectus, wayfinding, and admissions booth surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the campus visual identity, photography tone, information-panel rhythm, and color system. Images 02-04 preserve the same enrollment brand language while changing the deliverable surface.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-open-day-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-prospectus-cover, 03-campus-wayfinding-board, 04-admissions-booth-hero. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-open-day-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
